Sunnyside Backyard

Labraduck

Labrador + Duck

Option A

A bright quack with the body of a single bark.

Option B

A low, rumbling guard call with a duck accent.

Option C

Two quick notes with an answering woof in the second.

Bunblebee

Bumblebee + Rabbit

Option A

Wing swell. A single bumblebee fly-by with a rabbit oink emerging from the buzz.

Option B

Curious oinks. A pair of quick rabbit calls with a low wing hum underneath.

Option C

Double flutter. Two naturally different bumblebee passes, with a rabbit grunt folded into the second pulse.

Cockapoodle

Cockatoo + Poodle

Option A

Bright yap. A fast poodle bark with a sharp cockatoo note opening into its tail.

Option B

Questioning squawk. A longer cockatoo roll with a low poodle accent near the end.

Option C

Double alert. Two cockatoo pulses with the sharper poodle onset tucked into the second.

Clover Farm

Cluckitty

Chicken + Kitten

Curious mewl

A soft kitten-led call with a pulsing cluck inside its attack.

Purr-cluck

A quick, chicken-led call with a short kitten reply folded into its tail.

Question trill

A gentler, drawn-out kitten call with short hen notes that break up the middle.

Donkeyote

Donkey + Coyote

Option A

Rolling hee-yip. A forward donkey bray curls into a coyote howl.

Option B

Double warning. A sharp coyote bark leads into two clipped donkey pulses.

Option C

Low prairie call. A heavier bray holds under a smoother, airy howl.

Flamingoat

Flamingo + Goat

Option A

Breezy honk. A short flamingo opening with a clear goat note carrying the sound forward.

Option B

Stuttering bleat. A goat-led call with little flamingo pulses inside its held note.

Option C

Double honk. Two flamingo phrases separated by a compact goat answer.

Woolrus

Sheep + Walrus

Option A

Baa-rumble. A rounded sheep bleat that takes on a walrus rumble as it starts.

Option B

Short huff. A compact walrus grunt with a lighter sheep reply.

Option C

Rolling baa. A pair of walrus pulses shapes a sheep note into a bouncy call.

Ripplewater Lake

Crocodoodle Doo

Crocodile + Rooster

Raspy dawn crow

A rising rooster crow with a Nile crocodile chirr threaded through its middle.

Sharp river chirr

A low juvenile crocodile chirr with a short rooster accent.

Two-note wake-up call

A brief blend opens the call, followed by a higher crow with a second crocodile chirr.

Goosemoose

Canada Goose + Moose

Bright antler honk

A clear Canada goose honk with a low moose note beneath it.

Deep marsh call

A moose-led grunt with the goose honk rising out of the middle.

Double honk

Two short calls, with a brighter first honk and a heavier answering one.

Hootopotamus

Owl + Hippopotamus

Round hoot

A rounded owl hoot with a short hippo grunt tucked into its attack.

Swamp bellow

A chesty hippo bellow with an owl tone swelling over it.

Two-step hoot

A short grunt-hoot followed by a fuller, higher hoot.

Jungle Wilds

Tigebra

Tiger + Zebra

Option A

Low rattling growl. A tiger growl rolls into a short burst of zebra chatter.

Option B

Quick nasal snap. A bright zebra bark has a short tiger snarl underneath.

Option C

Rising rasp. A longer zebra bray rises into an open tiger roar.

Golden Dunes

Swobra

Swan + Cobra

Option A

Trumpet hiss. A rounded swan call opens into a soft cobra hiss.

Option B

Striking call. The cobra snaps first, with a darker swan note swelling behind it.

Option C

Fluttering double call. Two lighter swan pulses chatter through a quick hiss.

Cloudstone Caverns

Froggle

Frog + Eagle

Option A

High chirrup, an eagle note with a quick ribbit crackle underneath.

Option B

Purring croak with a hollow eagle accent that rises out of it.

Option C

Two bouncy notes, each a ribbit fused to a short eagle chirp.
